stages.log: Forty crates of the Hallorans' went out your airlock. Bring them back, crate by crate, and square it with the family. Ferris's job, on the board: eleven of the crates, out of the customs pound.

objectives.text: Win Eleven crates on the board

stages.why: The ship launched: the job went to someone else.

stages.log: Eleven crates back in Halloran hands. Old Halloran sends word that it's a start. The other twenty-nine crates, adrift where you dumped them: marked on the chart.
stages.why: The run left the charts behind.

stages.log: The Hallorans' runner at their drop, within reach of the colony: their collectors hold her.
